items.title: Breaking: Blow for Gina Rinehart as Wright Prospecting awarded royalties in legal fight
items.description: Gina Rinehart is dealt a blow, with a court finding the family of her father's former business partner has the right to potentially hundreds of millions of dollars in royalties from lucrative Pilbara mining assets.

items.title: Virgin joins Qantas in cutting domestic flights as fuel costs hit airlines
items.description: Australian airlines are halting entire routes and merging slots to ensure planes are full, as the aviation industry battles soaring jet fuel costs and likely supply uncertainty over the coming months.

items.title: Your brain explained: Why it's getting harder to pay attention
items.description: If it feels harder to concentrate than it used to, it's not just you. Scientists say your brain is reacting exactly as it was designed to — but in a very different world.

items.title: Live: Trump says peace talks could restart in days as blockade 'completely' halts maritime Iranian trade
items.description: The talks come as both the US and Iran continue to impose their own separate restrictions on the flow of vessels in and out of the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: Finance giant fined millions for sending unstoppable spam
items.description: Latitude Financial has been fined millions of dollars for a repeated breach of spam laws, including promoting credit cards without giving recipients a way to opt-out.

items.title: King Charles to have tea with Donald Trump during US trip
items.description: King Charles will have tea and a private meeting with US President Donald Trump during his US state visit later this month, with trips to Washington, New York and Virginia.

items.title: New footage captures moment Artemis II crew welcomed home
items.description: New footage shows the moment a recovery crew opens the hatch of Artemis II's Orion capsule and welcomes its crew members home after their mission around the Moon.

items.title: High Court throws out Victoria's $5k cap on political donations
items.description: Two independents have successfully argued Victorian political donation law was unfair and risked allowing wealthy voices to drown out others.

items.title: Fatal kick accused committed to stand trial
items.description: The man accused of delivering the blow that later killed a 22-year-old on the Gold Coast has been committed to stand trial.

items.title: What a 'super El Niño' would mean for Australia's weather in 2026
items.description: Australia's weather is expected to shift rapidly thanks to the probable emergence of an incoming El Niño, meaning drought, extreme heat and bushfires are on the way.

items.title: Live: ASX follows Wall Street higher, oil prices sink on hope of further US-Iran peace talks
items.description: The Australian share market has risen in morning trade as global investors bet on the US-Iran war being over within months, despite fuel shortages, higher inflation and a possible economic slowdown. Follow live.

items.title: Human remains found in remote burnt-out house near Bundaberg
items.description: Queensland Police find human remains at a home that was destroyed by fire on Saturday night. A couple who lived at the property remain unaccounted-for.

items.title: New images released with Hobart stadium precinct master plan
items.description: A master plan for the precinct surrounding the future AFL stadium in Hobart has been unveiled, while the ABC understands the company behind New Zealand's premier stadium in Christchurch is among those competing to build it.

items.title: Prince Harry tries his hand at AFL as Melbourne visit continues
items.description: The Duke of Sussex is joined by Western Bulldogs players at a Movember event in Melbourne's west.

items.title: Which shade of white is right? Dentists explain the teeth colours
items.description: Experts say there are many factors that influence how white a tooth appears, and it's not just about whitening or what we’re eating.

items.title: How The Babadook inspired the 'scariest movie you'll ever hear'
items.description: Filmed in director Ian Tuason's childhood home and based on his own experiences caring for his dying parents, Undertone has become a sleeper hit.

items.title: Quiz: We're going on a trip — don't forget your toothbrush
items.description: What are the pyramids made out of? And which Caribbean island doesn't appear in the Beach Boys song Kokomo?

items.title: Brothers living in squalor missed multiple health appointments, report finds
items.description: A 48-page report has been released on the interactions between health care workers and two siblings who were discovered living in squalor in May 2020.

items.title: Gold mine stops underground operations after magnitude-4.5 earthquake
items.description: All underground workers at Newmont's Cadia gold mine have been brought to the surface as inspections are carried out following an earthquake.

items.title: Developer claimed 'superior intellect' in mayor harassment case
items.description: A Southern Highlands developer facing harassment allegations says legal action is politically motivated, while police allege a pattern of emails and conduct targeting senior council officials.

items.title: 26yo man dead after violent disturbance in remote NT community
items.description: A man has died after a violent disturbance in Milingimbi yesterday, in which police allege some people were armed with edged weapons.

items.title: Player's umpire abuse verdict raises questions about AFL's 'conflict of interest'
items.description: The reporting of Port Adelaide player Zak Butters for umpire abuse sparks debate about whether officials should be involved with betting and if better audio recordings should be available from games.

items.title: Parisian man scoops 1-million-euro Picasso painting in raffle
items.description: A man from Paris has won a Picasso painting worth 1 million euros ($1.6 million) with a 100-euro raffle ticket.

items.title: 'Potential is significant': The untapped fuel source already on our shores
items.description: Australia controls less than 20 per cent of our liquid fuel supply and relies on imports for the other 80-plus per cent we need to keep the nation moving. But proponents of biofuels argue it does not need to be this way.

items.title: Trump lashes out at European ally Meloni amid tensions over pope and NATO
items.description: The US president says Giorgia Meloni "does not care" about Iran getting a nuclear weapon, after the Italian PM defended the pope and cancelled a military deal with Israel.
